messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding new tenant Helios into ap-east-3. We need to open p5, g5, and p4d entitlements for their account. Primary blockers: ENI ceiling on the account and small /22 subnets in the VPC. Can someone start the quota asks?

devops-jamie: +1. Which exact quotas do we need? I can open requests but want the counts to include in the case.

maria: Target numbers: p5: 8 instances, p4d: 6, g5: 24 initially. ENIs: bump by +500 for the account (we have multi-AZ pools). Also request EC2 On-Demand vCPU quota bump in the region by 12k vCPUs to avoid soft limits during scale tests.

sree: For subnets, Helios VPC currently has two /24s in us-east-style AZ mappings (bad plan). Suggest we create three /21s and reserve an IP pool for GPU nodes only. Otherwise ENI exhaustion will be immediate with 24 g5s.

ops-emanuel: Noted. Ill coordinate the subnet resize with networking. If we switch to larger subnets we need to update route tables and the NATGW placement. Also: are we doing public IPs or private with NAT? That affects NATGW throughput/cost.

maria: Private IPs + NATGW. Cost for NATGW is expected but acceptable. Helios prefers private-only for compliance. Add elastic IPs only for bastion.

devops-jamie: I'll open an AWS Support case now and request an entitlement bump + ENI increase + vCPU increase. Drafting description: 

```
Account: 123456789012 (Helios-prod)
Region: ap-east-3
Quotas requested:
 - p5 instances: 8 (p5dn.24xlarge)
 - p4d instances: 6
 - g5 instances: 24
 - EC2 On-Demand vCPUs: +12000
 - Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI): +500
Reason: New tenant onboarding, predictable reserved capacity for inference farms; cluster autoscaler and node pools will create simultaneous allocations during canary and soak tests.
```

devops-jamie: Tagging AWS TAM and infra-bot.

aws-tam-bot: AWS case opened: 1234-ABCD. Assigned TAM: Rei. Preliminary ETA for entitlement review: 72 hours. Please attach expected start date for workloads and mention any compliance constraints.

maria: Start date target: 2026-04-15 for initial canary. Add that HSM/KMS keys will be provisioned in the same region for Private deployment.

sree: Quick note on capacity selection: p5dn vs p5: p5dn has local NVMe volumes which reduce network attach times for large checkpoint deployments. If Helios runs lots of model loads during rollout, p5dn might help reduce cold-starts. Consider asking for a mix (we already included p5).

ops-emanuel: On the subnet plan, I'll provision three /21s and leave 25% of addresses reserved for management and monitoring nodes. I'll also add a secondary /22 for a dev/test pool. This should free enough ENIs per AZ.

devops-jamie: AWS asked for placement strategy and fallback plan. Proposed fallback: when quota not ready, route inference traffic to hosted Redwood fleet in us-east-1 and enable canary at 10% traffic. Also add autoscaler policy to limit concurrent instance boots to 6 to avoid large simultaneous requests to AWS.

maria: Good. Please include estimated cost delta if we pre-warm with reserved instances vs running on-demand for first 30 days. Helios wants cost guidance.

devops-jamie: Quick estimate: on-demand mix for requested capacity ~ $280k/month (raw instance cost only). Reserved 1yr partial upfront could cut ~30%. I'll add numbers to support case.

infra-bot: Preflight checks: detected default security groups allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 in Helios-prod VPC. Recommend tightening before we hand off to security review.

maria: Thanks infra-bot — scheduled security scrub. ops-emanuel please remediate.

ops-emanuel: Will do. One more ask from AWS: provide list of AMIs we plan to use and whether we rely on Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) or Nitro-based enhanced networking. Helios workloads use NCCL and EFA for all-reduce; we should request EFA-enabled quota too.

sree: Add EFA interfaces: request 48 EFA-enabled instances quota (equivalent to the p4d/p5 nodes above) and ask for ENI types that support EFA.

devops-jamie: Updated case notes to include EFA and AMI IDs. Replied to TAM with these details. Also requested priority escalation citing production onboarding timeline.

aws-tam-bot: TAM reply: We can escalate to regional capacity team after reviewing utilization patterns. Please provide expected daily sustained vCPU utilization and peak boot concurrency.

maria: Expected sustained vCPU utilization: 60% across fleet. Peak boot concurrency: ~40 nodes (during canary and model preloads). Add that to the case.

devops-jamie: Done. Case updated (1234-ABCD). AWS asked for a follow-up call; scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (pm Asia). I'll send calendar invite.

ops-emanuel: Also adding an AWS config to create an ENI fallback pool in a secondary account (cross-account ENI allocation): this reduces single-account ceiling pressure. Need account IDs from finance.

maria: Finance will share the account IDs. Last item: please add a note in onboarding runbook to retry instance provisioning with smaller batches if we see ENI throttles, and add metrics in Console dashboard for ENI usage by tenant.

sree: Will add to runbook and create alert: ENI usage >= 80% triggers pager to eng-infra oncall.

maria: Thanks team. I'll follow up once AWS confirms entitlements. :thumbsup:
